Security Guard Shares Meal with Wife Outside Bank

A security guard working the night shift at an HDFC Bank was seen sharing a home-cooked meal with his wife outside the closed bank. A video of the couple eating together, shared on X, moved social media users, highlighting the importance of relationships and expressing love through small gestures.
